added.name: Allia Health
added.long_description:
Allia is the first AI-native clinical group for behavioral health. We bring hundreds of independent practices across all 50 states into one national group that can deliver, measure, and improve care at scale.

Nearly 1,000 therapy and psychiatry practices already run on our free platform, supporting >300,000 patients and nearly 1 million monthly visits. That's our wedge. We activate high-performing practices into our medical group, which now spans ~600 providers and ~70 sites, in-person in 32 states and telehealth in all 50 — with signed contracts with the country's largest health insurance payers.

Behavioral health is the largest part of healthcare no one has organized: unmeasured, buried in admin, and fragmented across tiny practices. Being one clinically integrated group, powered by a single-instance OS (EHR, CRM, and RCM in one), is what makes care measurable, accountable, and coordinated — efficiently and at scale.
added.one_liner: Clinically Integrated Group for Mental Health

Ravion is the agent-native cloud infrastructure platform for AWS.

It gives developers, AI agents, and DevOps one governed place to provision, deploy, and operate applications in their own AWS account.

Get production-grade AWS without building every DevOps capability yourself. Start with production-ready modules and pipelines, bring existing infrastructure, customize the system, and adopt Ravion incrementally as your needs grow.

long_description.before:
Broccoli is building the AI-native operating system for home service businesses. Running a plumbing or HVAC company is chaotic: calls, scheduling, dispatch, follow-ups, marketing. We automate all of it so contractors can focus on what they do best: serving customers.

Our AI agents handle both revenue and ops; answering phones 24/7, booking jobs in real time, following up on leads, and alerting techs when emergencies hit.

We’ve grown from 0 to 800+ contractors in under 2 years, raised Series A round led by Khosla Ventures to take on one of the biggest labor automation opportunities in the country.

AJ is a Computer Science graduate from BITS Pilani. He started his career at Adobe and has built companies with Adi for nine years.  
Adi is a Computer Science graduate from BITS Pilani. He did research at the CVC lab at UAB Barcelona and worked at Microsoft before he built companies with AJ.  
Together, they founded Telematica, where they built energy-management systems for large European utilities and charging-point operators. They raised $1.5M for Telematica and $25M for Broccoli.

long_description.before: Revyl is a development platform that lets agents, product, design, and engineering ask questions, collaborate, and code on a single source of truth; starting with mobile
long_description.after:
Revyl is the mobile development platform for agents, developers, product, and design. It brings development, build infrastructure, verification, and application intelligence together in one platform, giving teams and agents a shared source of truth for every mobile application.

Teams can build and run mobile applications in the cloud, understand how their applications work, collaborate across functions, and verify changes against the running app. AI agents gain the context and runtime they need to move beyond simply generating code and understand whether their work actually works.

By connecting the people and agents building software to the application itself, Revyl helps teams move faster, collaborate more effectively, and build mobile with confidence.

long_description.before: ​Nixo is the platform FDE teams use to unlock SaaS-level margins from services work. Connect customer conversations, engineering todos, and project delivery in one place to turn your custom work into repeatable leverage.

Scale deployed revenue with the only data layer and agent platform built for how FDEs actually work.

Your deployment capacity boils down to how many accounts your team can stay on top of. We figured out how you can create more of it with the FDE motion you already have.

Nixo is built on what the best FDE teams already know: when everyone has a clear view of what was promised, where every account stands, what needs attention next, and what can be reused from past work, the whole team can carry more deployments. Nixo automatically captures the full history and live health of every account from pre-sales through post-go-live, no matter who worked on it last or where the information lives. Our agents use that context to find, scope, and prioritize work across the portfolio, so anyone can move any account forward.

Join the hundreds of FDE teams scaling deployment capacity with Nixo and finally unlock SaaS-level margins from your services.

long_description.before: Litmus is the most accurate read on how an engineer actually builds. We evaluate candidates through async technical assessments built from your own tech context (repos, tickets, and job descriptions), generated from scratch and scoped as real end-to-end features. Candidates work in their own setup with all their tools including AI, while we track and evaluate their process and output. Every submission runs in a sandbox, and grading is tuned to your company across tool fluency, process, and outcome. You get a real read on how someone actually builds, not just how they interview.
long_description.after:
Litmus gives back the hours your team burns on interviews, while holding every candidate to your technical bar. It builds assessments from your repos, tickets, and job descriptions, and candidates work through them in their own setup with the tools they actually use. Litmus runs and tests every submission, and grades outcome, process, and tool fluency, down to AI prompting.

Send assessments async to filter unqualified applicants before an engineer wastes an hour on a call. Or run them live, where Litmus tracks everything candidates say and build, so your engineers can focus on the person instead of taking notes, and the scorecard is written before they leave the call.

It's sent 3,000+ assessments on behalf of Neo Scholars, Mercor, Composio, and more.

Over time, every job feeds your Company Brain, so your best technicians’ expertise never leaves the company.

Kebra captures what happens in the field and turns it into a live operating memory that AI can query and act on.

We deploy AI agents on top of that context to automate the operational and back office work that follows across the systems companies already use.

Every job makes the memory richer. We are building the context layer for the physical enterprise, giving software agents the information they need today and physical agents the company specific context they will need tomorrow.

long_description.before:
Denta saves companies money and time on dental insurance. In two minutes, employers can sign up directly, without dealing with the middlemen who add 25% to the cost.

I started Denta after building software for my dad's 10 dental practices. In scaling the software business to 16k MRR in 10 weeks, I realized I was working on a small problem in dentistry. Existing software sucks, no doubt, but what dentists complain about even more: insurance.

Dental insurance carriers collect $100B per year in premiums. 25% of that is wasted on administrators, brokers, and c-suite salaries. As the son of a dentist, I will not let these companies burn $25B a year. That money should go to employers via reduced costs, dentists via reimbursements, and patients via more coverage.
